title: Notice Length and the Early Exit Charge Under Workplace Cafe Management Program Commercial Terms
content:
Where the calendar days from the day written notice of termination was given to the day the charge is raised reach the termination notice printed against the service model and a resumption request stands approved on the contract, the notice given beyond that termination notice is counted in whole weeks and the exit charge before allowances is reduced for each of them by one fiftieth of itself rounded to the nearest cent, a part week being left unrelieved; where those calendar days reach the termination notice printed against the service model and no resumption request stands approved on the contract, the notice given beyond that termination notice is counted in calendar days and the exit charge before allowances is reduced for each of them by one three hundred and fiftieth of itself rounded to the nearest cent; and where those calendar days fall short of the termination notice printed against the service model, no notice relief is given on that charge.

Notice is measured in calendar days from the day written notice of termination was given to the day the charge is raised, against the termination notice printed against the service model held on the cafe management contract.

Where a resumption request stands approved on the contract, that notice beyond is counted in whole weeks and a part week is left unrelieved. Where no resumption request stands approved on the contract, that notice beyond is counted in calendar days, every such day counting.

Hypothetically, under the Workplace Cafe Management Program, a contract whose printed termination notice is 75 calendar days, written notice of termination given 103 calendar days before the day the charge is raised, and an exit charge before allowances of 20000.00 USD: the calendar days reach the printed termination notice, and the notice given beyond it is 28 calendar days. With a resumption request standing approved, that beyond-notice is counted as 4 whole weeks, one fiftieth of the exit charge before allowances is 400.00 USD rounded to the nearest cent, and the relief is that figure taken 4 times, being 1600.00 USD. With no resumption request standing approved, that beyond-notice is counted as 28 calendar days, one three hundred and fiftieth of the exit charge before allowances is 57.14 USD rounded to the nearest cent, and the relief is that figure taken 28 times, being 1599.92 USD. Had written notice been given only 70 calendar days before the day the charge is raised, those calendar days would fall short of the printed termination notice of 75 calendar days and no notice relief is given on that charge.
